mappings._doc_justification: NetSuite Customer.companyname is the entity's display name for non-individual customers (SuiteScript Records Browser). Rootstock Customer__c is built on the Salesforce platform; every Salesforce custom object exposes a standard `Name` field that serves as the display label in the SF UI. For a NetSuite-to-Rootstock migration, mapping companyname → Name preserves the human-readable identity of the customer record. The 1:1 mapping is canonical because both systems treat this as 'the name shown in the UI for this customer'.
_doc_citations: Salesforce Object Reference — standard Name field on custom objects

gold.notes: Difficulty: easy. Two well-documented fields with semantically symmetric purposes. Note: NetSuite customers can be either entities (companyname populated) or individuals (firstname + lastname populated; companyname null). For individual customers, the Name mapping needs a different rule — but that's a different example for PR 10.5b. The calibration sample here covers the entity case only.

uncertainty_flags: Individual-customer case (firstname + lastname → Name) is out of scope for this single example; PR 10.5b should add a separate example for that path.
